classification: Local implementation and synthetic acquisition evidence; not model qualification, public seed, release or deployment.
question: Does the install lifetime cover pending metadata hashes before store or transfer side effects?

before.interpretation: Sixteen stage/cancellation/late-outcome subcases and their parent failed; the independent hash-failure control passed. Each failed subcase remained pending after the 150 ms observation window. Recorded before the implementation change in this operation.

change.late_result: Observe rejected promises even when cancellation happened synchronously during the operation call; ignore late settlement after terminal outcome.
unchanged: Committed-store success on cancellation after durable commit
